Subject: Commitment onboarding: annual prepay cadence & drawdown plan

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Before we lock the contract I'm pulling together our internal billing ops checklist. Two asks so we can finalize the PO:

1) Proposed invoicing cadence for a $1.2M annual prepay (we prefer quarterly invoices but need a drawdown window defined).
2) VAT handling for our EU entity (we need the invoice fields you require and whether Redwood can route VAT IDs by entity).

Could you share a sample invoice + a provisional schedule that maps drawdown dates to invoices and the ledger tags you use for committed spend? Also flag any lead times your finance team needs for invoices to hit our AP cutoffs.

Appreciate it — copying our procurement and finance inboxes.

Sara Burns
Head of Finance Operations | Brightlane Systems
Attachments: none
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Burns <sara.burns@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commitment onboarding: annual prepay cadence & drawdown plan

Sara —

Thanks — attached is a first-pass schedule and sample invoice for a $1.2M annual prepay. High level:

- We can do quarterly invoices (T+15 billing) or calendar-tranche billing; attached schedule uses quarterly tranches with monthly drawdown windows attached to each invoice so you can align with your usage checks.
- VAT: Redwood invoices support per-entity VAT IDs and a VAT breakdown line. For EU entities we need the receiving entity + VAT ID before the first invoice so we can populate the tax fields.
- Ledgers: we tag committed spend to an account code (Commit-YYYY) and include a metadata CSV on every invoice batch for easy GL mapping.

Attachments: Redwood_2026_prepay_schedule_v1.xlsx (contains provisional calendar, sample invoice, drawdown windows, and ledger tag CSV stub).

Next steps: can you confirm the billing entity name and the PO number? If procurement wants a different cadence we can update the schedule and re-run the drawdown calendar.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0162

Sara / team —

Quick operational notes from Finance Ops:

- Invoice numbering: Redwood issues one invoice per tranche with a prefix (RDW-CP-<year>-<seq>). If you require a specific invoice reference, send the PO format and we will include it in the invoice header.
- VAT evidence: please upload a signed VAT registration certificate for the EU entity (pdf) to the HubSpot file link or attach to an email; we will record VAT ID on file and include the VAT breakdown.
- Cutoffs: for T+15 billing to meet Brightlane AP cycles we need finalized PO/Entity confirmation at least 5 business days prior to each invoice date.
- Drawdown reconciliation: we provide a monthly CSV with token usage and drawdown remaining; recommend a monthly review for the first two quarters.

Attaching a small bundle of invoice_samples.zip (sample PDF + csv stub) to show the fields.

If Brightlane wants a 60/40 split for first/second tranche (instead of even quarters) we can model that in the schedule; tell us preferred percentages and dates.

—Kimberly Park
Revenue Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Invoice_Samples.zip
